Interface RmiServerRemote

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiClientHandler
public interface RmiServerRemote extends Remote
RMI remote interface exposing client-to-server game and lobby operations.

Each method corresponds to a player action. On the server side these calls land on the RMI thread pool and are forwarded to VirtualControllerManager. The symmetrical inversion-of-control pattern is implemented on the Socket transport via Command.apply(VirtualControllerManager, String).
